question: Which deity occupies the single central division in the upapīṭha plot?
premises: The upapīṭha plot has a central division.
A specific deity occupies that central division.
inference: Pitāmaha occupies the single central division in the upapīṭha plot.
plain_english: And in the upapīṭha plot, Pitāmaha occupies one division in the middle.
